{{Use mdy dates|date=February 2025}} {{WGA awards short description|works-year=2013}} {{Infobox film awards|number=66|award=WGA Awards|date=February 1, 2014|organizer=[[Writers Guild of America, East]] and the [[Writers Guild of America, West]]|last=[[65th Writers Guild of America Awards|65th]]|next=[[67th Writers Guild of America Awards|67th]]}} The '''66th [[Writers Guild of America Award]]s''' honor the best [[Screenwriter|film, television, radio and video-game writers]] of 2013. The television and radio nominees were announced on December 5, 2013. Film nominees were announced on January 3, 2014. All winners were announced on February 1, 2014, at the [[JW Marriott Hotels|JW Marriott hotel]] in the [[L.A.
